attractions.name: Machu Picchu Historic Sanctuary
attractions.description: 15th-century Inca citadel high in the Andes, rediscovered in 1911; UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, with terraces, temples and ceremonial plazas.
tips: A shuttle bus runs between Aguas Calientes and Machu Picchu

attractions.name: Machu Picchu
attractions.description: Inca citadel explored via circuit routes such as Route 1C and Route 3B with a guide
tips: Take the shuttle bus from Aguas Calientes up to Machu Picchu
attractions._source_file: South America/All Inclusive Guide - Peru- Neha and Mayur.pdf

safety_tips.tip: Stay hydrated and avoid strenuous activity on the first day at altitude

transport_options.description: Shuttle bus between Aguas Calientes (Machu Picchu Pueblo) and the Machu Picchu site.
transport_options.covers: Aguas Calientes to Machu Picchu and return

health_tips.tip: Cusco sits at 3,400 m (11,150 ft); allow time to acclimatise and keep the first day relaxed
UV index is very high in the Andes even on cool days; wear sunscreen, sunglasses and a hat
Walk slowly and take your time at altitude
